none: PAS NLM-AB0400: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Gloria Romanorum issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped and/or cuirassed right. Reverse description: Emperor advancing left holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.72gms, die axis: 12
